recurring_themes: weighs staying abroad versus returning home for parents
current_goals: decide whether to return home when father's health declines
known_constraints: employer sponsorship tied to current role
about_me: Chen Wei, 31, software engineer in Berlin with family in Guanghua, China.
priorities: Be present for parents without derailing career
user_priorities: Be present for parents without derailing career

past_decisions.situation_summary: Mother asked Chen to return for a year to help with father's recovery.
past_decisions.chosen_option: Negotiated three-month remote work from Guanghua.
past_decisions.outcome: Helped family; project delays created stress with manager.

past_decisions.situation_summary: Compared sending larger remittances versus building emergency fund abroad.
past_decisions.chosen_option: Split 60% remittance / 40% savings for six months.
past_decisions.outcome: Parents covered medical bills; Chen had thin buffer when visa fees rose.

past_decisions.situation_summary: Offered internal transfer to Singapore office closer to family.
past_decisions.chosen_option: Declined transfer to keep Berlin tech network.
past_decisions.outcome: Career momentum continued; guilt about distance persisted.
